articles.title: Show HN: Truce – a neutral mediator that AI agents can call to settle disputes
articles.content: Hi HN, I'm Frank, founder of Truce.Truce is a neutral AI mediator. Each side tells it their side in private, Truce proposes one specific outcome, and nothing happens unless both people sign.The part that may interest you is the agent side. Truce is a remote MCP server (https://trucehq.com/mcp) with 12 tools, so an assistant can start a Truce for its user, or answer one for the other person with their consent.There is also "Agent Truce": two agents acting for different people or companies settle a dispute between themselves, such as a refund, a late delivery or an invoice. Each agent gives its side, its evidence and a private mandate from its human, for example "may pay up to $300". The mediator never sees either mandate, so it proposes on the merits. A proposal that fits inside both mandates is accepted automatically; anything else goes back to the humans. Truce never moves money.It's free for AI agents. One-minute demo on the page.I'd especially like criticism of the mandate design. H

articles.title: 2026 年 Steam 大奖提名开启：十周年新增「名人堂」特别奖项，11 月 30 日截止
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 24 日消息，Valve 正式开启 2026 年 Steam 大奖（Steam Awards）提名通道。本届大奖恰逢活动诞生十周年，官方在常规评选基础上增设了多项特别奖项，提名阶段将持续至太平洋时间 11 月 30 日上午 10 点（北京时间 12 月 1 日凌晨 2 点）。IT之家附 Steam 官方提名页面链接（https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations/2026）。为庆祝十周年，Valve 从往届经典奖项中回顾并带回了三项具有玩家情怀的评选类别：「再玩五分钟」（Just 5 More Minutes）：表彰那些让人沉浸其中、舍不得退出的游戏；「难以名状」（Defies Description）：授予风格独特、难以被归类的作品；「这就是我的工作了」（This is My Job Now）：颁给那些让玩家投入度高到仿佛成为第二份「工作」的游戏。此外，本届最受瞩目的新增内容为「名人堂」（Hall of Fame）特别奖项。该类别不参与当年新作评选，而是从历届 Steam「年度游戏」获奖作品中展开角逐，让《黑神话：悟空》《艾尔登法环》《博德之门 3》《空洞骑士：丝之歌》等曾获最高荣誉的经典作品跨年代同台竞技。按照官方日程安排，最终提名名单将于 12 月 17 日与 Steam 冬季特卖同步公布，届时玩家可进入投票通道，为心仪的作品投下决定性的一票。
